summary: Performs mathematical operations on image pixels, including per-channel unary operations, channel combining, multiply/add, range mapping, integer conversion, and invalid-value handling in newer builds.

key_params.name: preop
key_params.note: off, negate, pos, root, square, or inverse before channel combine

key_params.name: chanop
key_params.note: off, add, sub, mul, div, avg, min, max, or len

key_params.name: integer
key_params.note: off, ceiling, floor, or round integer handling

key_params.name: inputmask
key_params.note: Input channel mask used by channel-combine operation

key_params.name: outputchannels
key_params.note: Output channel mask for channel-combine operation

common_gotchas: Channel combine operates across selected channels for each pixel, not across neighboring pixels.
inputmask and outputchannels can silently exclude channels from the operation.
RGB divide-by-alpha modes have special fill behavior where alpha is zero.
Pixel format can clamp or quantize math results if left at an integer format.
Range mapping happens after the other math pages, so it can hide upstream values.
key_concepts: Performs math operations on image pixels and channels on the GPU.
Channel Pre OP and Post OP apply unary math before and after channel combination.
Combine Channels uses input and output masks to combine selected channels of each pixel.
Multi-Add applies pre-add, gain, and post-add in order.
Range mapping is the final conversion step before output.
The operator supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.
